Exp - Error handler.vi

Owning Palette: FuncVI Development

Use this VI to declare custom CalcExpress errors in FuncVIs.

Details

Click the parameters for more information

 

InstanceRef is the reference to the CalcExpress instance that evaluates a CalcExpress expression.
error message in defines an error message if cmd equals set. The VI appends the message to the end of the Error Protocol if cmd equals set and error in is TRUE.
add FuncName (T). If TRUE (by default), the VI appends a name of function associated with the calling FuncVI to the end of error message in when it puts the message to the Error Protocol.
cmd (1:set) specifies an operation to perform:

0initThe VI resets the error in CalcExpress instance context referred by InstanceRef and clears the Error Protocol. This operation executes if only error in is FALSE.
1setThe VI saves both an error status and error code specified by error code in to the CalcExpress instance context referred by InstanceRef, and appends error message in to the Error Protocol. This operation executes only if error in is TRUE, it has no effects if error in is FALSE. This is default value.
2getThe VI returns the error information stored in CalcExpress instance context referred by InstanceRef. It returns an error status in error out indicator, an error code in error code out indicator and contents of the Error Protocol in error message out indicator. This operation executes independently of error in state.
error in specifies an error condition occurred. The behavior of the VI depends on both error in and cmd values.
error code in specifies a custom error code that CalcExpress and CSE VIs will return if an error occurs. If it is equal to zero (by default), the default CalcExpress error code is stored; typically, it is Runtime Error code equal to 7103. The VI uses this control only if cmd is set and error in is TRUE.
error message out. If cmd is equal to get, it contains a values of the Error Protocol. Otherwise, it contains the same value as error message in.
error out. If cmd is equal to get, it contains an error status stored in the CalcExpress instance context referred by InstanceRef. It is TRUE if an error occurred; otherwise, it is FALSE. If cmd is other than get, error out contains the same value as error in.
error code out. If cmd is equal to get, it contains an error code stored in CalcExpress instance context referred by InstanceRef. If an error occurred, it can contain CalcExpress error code. LabVIEW error code, or a user-defined error code, if you specified any. If no error occurred, it contains zero. If cmd is other than get, error code out flows through and contains the exact same value passed to error code in.

 

Exp - Error handler.vi - details

The main objective of this VI is declaring errors in FuncVIs. The VI gives you direct access to the Error Protocol associated with the CalcExpress instance to which InstanceRef refers. In general, there is no need to immediately use this VI because CalcExpress VIs handle typical errors. However, you can use the VI to handle errors that are specific for your FuncVIs. With the help of this VI, you can specify an error description and an error code that are returned by CalcExpress and CSE VIs.
For details, see the FuncVI Development topic. Also see Example of use.
